reels.title: Replacing Large Language Models with Jev Decision Models for Low-Latency Edge Service Orchestration

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper offers a direct path to lowering AI latency—a high-interest topic for general viewers who experience 'lag' in daily interactions. Its hardware-efficiency focus aligns perfectly with our top-performing growth metrics.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if we could make AI smart enough to talk back instantly by replacing the 'brain' with a lightning-fast shortcut?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Replacing a slow, professional translator with a speed-reading index card system that triggers a pre-recorded response.
